question: T12 (task-23e237fca6436f9b, task-067e929f7d111a09), after CAP-T12WAVEDRAG: is a Wave Intensity drag's last stretch an undo step when it lets go on the value a pause left? And what does a press on another block do while a drag is held? On Blocks Probe at a 1600 by 1000 window, one new section per plan with a new Scrolling block and a Text block added after it, made on the desktop (desktop 1/2/3/26 and 1/2/3/10); T and N the Scrolling block alone; W a second Scrolling block instead of the Text block (it lands on 1/2/3/26 too). The Scrolling block selected, Edit, Design ('open'), then real pointer input through one DevTools session, the state read at each hold; then Escape ('go') and Cmd+Z, a read after each. U (desktop) and V (Mobile View, the frame 428 wide): 90 pressed, then a drag from 90: 300 ms there, 120 held 1300 ms, 150 300 ms, 120 300 ms, let go on 120. T: the same on the Scrolling block alone. N, alone: a drag from 0, 60 held 1300 ms, 120 300 ms, back to 0 300 ms, let go on 0. W: a drag from 0 to 60 and 120, 1200 ms apart, then 600 ms on 120, the pointer moved still held onto the second block's middle on the page, a second press there 300 ms (the button still down), let go there. R1 ran U, W, V with other plans (KLUWMV) and T, N (TNR); R2 the other order (VMWULK, RNT). Nothing saved: every session left by Exit Without Saving.
readsAre: reads: as CAP-T12TOPFALL (layout of the Scrolling block and every block in its section, the section rows in the view shown, the line, Undo and Redo, the panel's ranges; 'wave' the panel's Wave Intensity value). inputs: for each drag, states ([name, state]: value is the range's value, focus the focused element, undo [Undo on, Redo on], selected the selected blocks' ids, lines each Scrolling block's drawing height on the page) and log (the page's input, change and pointer events on the range, ms from the first). switchPoint: W's second block middle on the page, and what lies there. blockIds: each plan's blocks, as added.
answer: A drag's last stretch is an undo step also when it lets go on the value a pause left, and the model is as that pause's step left it. T, alone: 90 (1/2/5/26), the drag ends on 120 (1/2/5/26, line 154): Escape, Cmd+Z leaves 1/2/5/26 and the line at 154 with Redo on, Cmd+Z again the line at 124 (90), a third the section as built. A change fires at the let go (120 is not where the drag began).

With a Text block the same three steps: U ends 1/2/5/26 with the Text block at 4/2/6/10 (150 took it down, the one-step fall back to 120 left it); Cmd+Z 1/2/5/26 and 3/2/5/10 (the pause's 120), again the same areas (90), then the section as built. V in the phone view: 1/2/5/10 and 5/2/7/10, Cmd+Z 1/2/6/10 and 6/2/8/10 (the pause's 120), then 1/2/5/10 (90), then as built.
N, alone: 0, 60 held, 120, back to 0, let go on 0 (no change fires): two steps, Cmd+Z gives 60 (1/2/4/26, line 94), again the section as built.

Another block can't be selected during a drag. W: moved over the second block with the button down, the range follows the pointer to 0 (the block lies left of the panel), the first block's line falls to 34 and the second block's stays 34; a second press there changes nothing, the first block stays selected and the panel stays open on it; the let go there is the drag's let go. The first block ends 1/2/2/26 with Wave Intensity 0 and the second block keeps 0. Cmd+Z gives 60 (the first block 1/2/4/26), again the section as built.

W also shows the second Scrolling block, on the first's top row, stretched as the first grows (1/2/3/26 to 1/2/5/26 on the way to 120, read after the let go) and left so as it falls, not moved down as a Text block is (CAP-T12TOPFALL A). Not built here: task-d91d6e0d2f550874.
R1 and R2 read alike in every read and drag state (the block ids, and Undo and Redo at a plan's start, apart).
Not read: a pause shorter than 1.3 s before the way back; Item Spacing and Text Size; a drag let go over the page with no second press (ours keeps that let go); a touch.

localGuesses.written: none written before the reads; ours on main takes no step for T's last stretch (the change finds the model as the pause left it), so Cmd+Z goes back to 90 at once
